# Section

An opening paragraph, long enough to wrap, so the body style and its justification reach the output, with a footnote.[^1]

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: fig-bottom
#| fig-cap: "Bottom caption<br><span class='quarto-float-subcaption'>Subtitle line.</span>"
#| fig-height: 2

plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-top
#| fig-cap: "Top caption."
#| fig-cap-location: top
#| fig-height: 2

plot(1:3)
```

## Tables

::: {#tbl-md}
  | a   | b   |
  | --- | --- |
  | 1   | 2   |

A Markdown table caption.
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
#| tbl-cap: "A gt table caption."

gt::gt(head(mtcars[, 1:3], 3))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-anx-probe
#| tbl-cap: "An annexe caption."

knitr::kable(head(mtcars[, 1:2], 2))
```

Cross-references to @fig-bottom, @fig-top, @tbl-md, @tbl-gt and @anx-probe.

[^1]: A footnote.
